question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Mean
solution:
The correct answer is: **Noble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mean"** refers to someone who is unkind, spiteful, or unfair. It can also imply being of low quality or standard. (नीच)

 
 
• **Example: **He showed his mean side when he refused to help his friend in need.
 
 

 
• **"Noble" **refers to showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles and ideals. It denotes something that is of a superior quality or condition. (उच्च)

 
 
• **Example: **The noble act of saving the drowning child was praised by everyone in the town.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Mean' **is **'Noble'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Noble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Minute **(सूक्ष्म): Extremely small.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist used a microscope to observe the minute details of the cell.
 
 

 
• **Notorious **(कुख्यात ): Famous or well known, typically for some bad quality or deed.
 
 
• **Example: **The notorious criminal was finally captured by the police.
 
 

 
• **Novel** (नवीन): New or unusual in an interesting way.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist's novel approach to solving the problem received widespread acclaim.
